requirement: Every apply id an Apply writes under is kept on its site_brief row, reused receipts apart, and a finished run's late ids never land on its successor's row

oracle.ref: PR #893 (fix); fix evidence: Ledger L08, 05/10/2026: one Apply writes under several apply ids (dtrim-seed, contract-..., residue-..., tidy-..., mlang-..., facts-..., media-brief-...) and none was stored, so undoing an Apply as one was impossible; review then found reused receipts mixed in and a late run's ids able to land on a new run's row. Reds 83e6c54c9, a9e5d6937, 2bce2049d; fixes 57df42c37, 7f8ae873a, b7e441178.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# skipped 0', and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 152): the database cases ran, none skipped. Every named case is 'ok' (none 'not ok', none '# SKIP'): the door an engine writes through reports every apply_id a call names; the row keeps them in timings.applyIds (in order, once each, a failed run included) and the receipts it only reuses (the fixed dtrim-seed, the install’s mlang language receipt) in timings.reusedApplyIds, so undo reverts only its own; an engine of a run that ended never writes ids onto the row of the run that replaced it.
